testimonialsSection.title: What people say about working with me.

testimonials.quote: I've worked with Yuktarth for over three years, including more than a year as his direct manager. He has a good grasp of technical concepts, which helps him collaborate smoothly with engineering teams. He is especially strong when it comes to documentation and follow-through — clear PRDs, structured specs, and well-maintained trackers are areas where he brings a lot of discipline to the team.
testimonials.name: Sri Nitya Anupindi

testimonials.quote: Yuktarth is the 'silent warrior' you are looking for. It is rare to find a professional who combines a Computer Science background with an MBA and actually utilizes both skill sets equally well. In a chaotic environment, he is the anchor: calm, composed, and obsessively organized. If you want a Product Manager who delivers beyond par, hire Yuktarth.
testimonials.name: Yashdeep
testimonials.role: AI Technical Product Lead · hired Yuktarth

testimonials.quote: I had the pleasure of working with Yuktarth during his tenure in the AI Project Management team at SBI Card, and he consistently demonstrated exceptional ownership, technical clarity, and a strong problem-solving mindset. What truly sets him apart is his ability to coordinate seamlessly across stakeholders, vendors, developers, and testers.
testimonials.name: Bhrigu Rana

testimonials.quote: As a Product Manager, he expertly managed numerous internal and external feature releases on our customer care digital assistant and smart agent assist solution, consistently achieving minimal issues post-launch. He possesses a fantastic blend of technical understanding and business acumen.
testimonials.name: Puneet Singh
